entities.display_name: Capital allowance for investment in depreciable assets
entities.act_name: Inland Revenue Amendment Act No. 11 of 2026
entities.quote: “(2 A) A capital allowance equal to 100% of the investment made by a person in depreciable assets in a new undertaking, other than intangible assets, during a year of assessment shall be granted to such person for that year of assessment, if the total investment in such depreciable assets that are used in such undertaking in any part of Sri Lanka exceeds USD 250,000, but does not exceed USD 3 million.”.
